decisions.reason: The Body CT notebook loads a real DICOM dataset downloaded from Kaggle via pydicom, so a 'real' dataset_type is genuinely present alongside the synthetic Shepp-Logan phantom.

The 169 qubits are explicitly for the 15x15 binary Shepp-Logan sub-study; the paper spans multiple image sizes (2x2, 30x30, 50x50) each with its own qubit count, so this is a per-configuration value, not a same-configuration contradiction.

The 10,000 shots are tied specifically to the QPU solver Advantage_system6.1 run on the 15x15 phantom; other notebooks use LeapHybridSampler or num_reads of 100/500, so this is a per-configuration value rather than a same-configuration disagreement with the extracted 1000 annealings.
decisions.evidence_quote: Trial: 50 times with 10,000 shots for each time

decisions.reason: The lowest energy -8273.12 for the 15x15 Shepp-Logan hybrid-solver reconstruction is stated verbatim and is a distinct metric of the paper's own method.
All notebooks (toy and main) use D-Wave quantum annealing on QUBO (DWaveSampler/LeapHybridSampler with sample_qubo, Advantage_system6.1), which genuinely contradicts the extracted QAOA paradigm.
